title: A prospective randomized study of patient-centered AI for clinical visit preparation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician rev

translated_title: 以患者为中心的人工智能辅助临床就诊准备的前瞻性随机研究
translated_abstract: 患者在参加时间短暂、日程紧凑的临床就诊时，常常不清楚该期待什么、该问些什么，如今有数以百万计的成年人会借助通用AI聊天机器人在就诊前进行准备。然而，对话式AI能否改善患者的就诊准备状态仍不清楚。我们设计了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的就诊准备智能体，通过收集临床背景信息、设定就诊预期、提供相关健康信息、为临床医生构建按优先级排序的问题清单并生成总结，在就诊前为患者提供引导。在Google Health应用中进行的一项前瞻性、经知情同意的随机研究中，802名美国成年人使用就诊准备智能体（标准版或简洁版）或基于同一大语言模型构建的仅有最少提示的对照聊天机器人，共进行了866次健康相关对话。在盲法临床医生评估和患者自我报告中，就诊准备智能体的表现均显著优于对照组。在临床医生评审……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究开发了基于大语言模型的患者就诊准备智能体，并通过802名成年人参与的前瞻性随机试验证明，该智能体在帮助患者做好就诊准备方面显著优于通用聊天机器人。
en_tdlr: This prospective randomized study of 802 U.S. adults shows that an LLM-based visit preparation agent significantly outperforms a minimally prompted control chatbot in improving patients' clinical visit readiness, as judged by both blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports.
